title: Small hole in the wall Mexican restaurant with a weird bathroom.
content: So there’s this Mexican spot I dreamt about. It’s on an ordinary street with trees. Go in it’s got the dinning area though small, and to the right is a door the the kitchen, and across from it, a staircase to the restroom. So you walk down these stairs going down like a spiral and you see the bathroom. Its like a huge dungeon. Walls and ceiling made of cobble stone and the ceiling is rounded. The floor is wet and concrete is mostly chipped away leaving dirt. Lighting is ok considering there’s windows high up on the wall. A lonely toilet on one side, and a bunch of urinals on the other. Not a place Id wanna go back to. Even in the dream I felt grossed out.
